name: Balinese Water Temples: coordination and pest growth
description: Janssen's Fig. 3: the scale of coordination at pest growth g 2.0, 2.2 and 2.4 (middle rain; the search as in bali-levels), under each reading of the dam columns. Measured (release, seeds 1–3, all alike, recorded 2026-09-29), levels 1 → 172: code's columns g 2.0 27.65, 27.65, 27.65, 27.70, 27.71, 27.90; g 2.2 27.05, 27.05, 27.05, 27.09, 27.09, 27.25; g 2.4 25.98, 25.98, 25.98, 26.00, 26.01, 26.13. Physical columns g 2.0 26.35, 26.35, 26.35, 26.69, 26.58, 27.29; g 2.2 25.79, 25.79, 25.79, 25.99, 26.00, 26.75; g 2.4 24.79, 24.79, 24.79, 24.96, 24.97, 25.57. Faster pests cost every level alike, and the benefit of coordination is no larger at g 2.2 than at 2.0 (Janssen: at 2.2 only).
